title: Warboard Chess
short_description: 3D battle-chess: command living pieces that fight to the death on every capture, across shifting battlefields.
description: Warboard Chess is full 3D chess where every piece is an animated warrior. Play the classic game — legal moves, check, checkmate, castling and en passant — but when you capture, your piece marches in and strikes while the defender falls before it leaves the board. Each match is set in a different environment (mountain pass, forest clearing, desert mesa, frozen tundra), with the sky, ground and lighting changing to match. Face a tactical AI, orbit the board freely, and hunt the enemy king.
controls_keyboard: Left-click a piece to select · click a highlighted square to move · Right-drag rotate camera · scroll zoom · Esc pause
